// Generated from src/contract.ts. Do not edit directly.
type CommonPayloadProperties = CustomFunction.CommonPayloadProperties;
type CommonsExtraProperties = CustomFunction.CommonExtras;
declare namespace EnvironmentGlobals {
    interface Environment {}
}
/**
 * Customer-facing types available to every Transcend Custom Function.
 *
 * Import this namespace in a local project, or use it directly in Transcend's
 * Custom Function editor.
 */
declare namespace CustomFunction {
    /** A privacy request operation delivered to a data subject request function. */
    type RequestAction = 'ACCESS' | 'ERASURE' | 'RECTIFICATION' | 'RESTRICTION' | 'BUSINESS_PURPOSE' | 'PLACE_ON_LEGAL_HOLD' | 'REMOVE_FROM_LEGAL_HOLD' | 'AUTOMATED_DECISION_MAKING_OPT_OUT' | 'USE_OF_SENSITIVE_INFORMATION_OPT_OUT' | 'CONTACT_OPT_OUT' | 'SALE_OPT_OUT' | 'TRACKING_OPT_OUT' | 'CUSTOM_OPT_OUT' | 'AUTOMATED_DECISION_MAKING_OPT_IN' | 'USE_OF_SENSITIVE_INFORMATION_OPT_IN' | 'SALE_OPT_IN' | 'TRACKING_OPT_IN' | 'CONTACT_OPT_IN' | 'CUSTOM_OPT_IN';
    /** The channel through which a privacy request entered Transcend. */
    type RequestOrigin = 'PRIVACY_CENTER' | 'ADMIN_DASHBOARD' | 'API' | 'SHOPIFY';
    /** An environment variable configured for the Custom Function. */
    interface Environment {
        /** Environment variable value by name. */
        [name: string]: string;
    }
    /** The authenticated identifier attached to every invocation. */
    interface CoreIdentifier {
        /** The identifier value. */
        value: string;
    }
    /** The class of data subject making the request. */
    interface DataSubject {
        /** Customer-defined data subject type. */
        type: string;
    }
    /** A custom field attached to a privacy request. */
    interface RequestAttribute {
        /** Custom field name. */
        key?: string;
        /** Values assigned to the custom field. */
        values?: [
            string,
            ...string[]
        ];
    }
    /** Consent partition information attached to a privacy request. */
    interface Partition {
        /** Partition row ID. */
        id: string;
        /** Human-readable partition name. */
        name: string;
        /** Unique partition key. */
        partition: string;
    }
    /** Preference choice included with a consent-purpose change. */
    interface PreferenceChoice {
        /** Selected scalar value. */
        selectValue?: string;
        /** Selected list values. */
        selectValues?: string[];
        /** Selected boolean value. */
        booleanValue?: boolean;
    }
    /** Preference included with a consent-purpose change. */
    interface Preference {
        /** Preference topic. */
        topic: string;
        /** Current preference choice. */
        choice: PreferenceChoice;
    }
    /** Consent-purpose change that triggered the workflow. */
    interface PurposeChange {
        /** Purpose name. */
        purpose: string;
        /** Whether the purpose is enabled. */
        enabled: boolean;
        /** Current preferences associated with the purpose. */
        preferences?: Preference[];
    }
    /** Privacy request metadata shared by data subject request payloads. */
    interface Request {
        /** Free-form details added to the request. */
        details: string;
        /** Request ID. */
        id: string;
        /** URL path to the request in Transcend. */
        link: string;
        /** ISO-8601 creation timestamp. */
        createdAt: string;
        /** IETF BCP 47 locale. */
        locale: string;
        /** Channel through which the request entered Transcend. */
        origin: RequestOrigin;
        /** Custom fields attached to the request. */
        attributes?: RequestAttribute[];
        /** ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, when available. */
        country?: string;
        /** ISO 3166-2 country subdivision code, when available. */
        countrySubDivision?: string;
        /** Consent partition to which the request is scoped. */
        partition?: Partition;
    }
    /** Transcend organization that owns the Custom Function. */
    interface Organization {
        /** Organization ID. */
        id: string;
        /** Organization URI. */
        uri: string;
        /** Human-readable organization name. */
        name: string;
    }
    /** Metadata shared by data subject request payloads. */
    interface CommonExtras {
        /** Privacy request being processed. */
        request: Request;
        /** Organization that owns the request. */
        organization: Organization;
        /** Consent-purpose change that triggered this request, when applicable. */
        purpose?: PurposeChange;
    }
    /** Fields shared by data subject request payloads. */
    interface CommonPayloadProperties {
        /** Privacy request operation. */
        type: RequestAction;
        /** Information about the person making the request. */
        dataSubject: DataSubject;
        /** Whether this is a test request. */
        isTest: boolean;
    }
    /** Profile that a datapoint function should look up. */
    interface Profile {
        /** Transcend profile ID. */
        id: string;
        /** Request-data-silo queue row ID. */
        RequestDataSiloId: string;
        /** Identifier value to look up. */
        identifier: string;
        /** Identifier descriptor, such as `email`. */
        type: string;
    }
    /** Integration associated with a datapoint invocation. */
    interface DataSilo {
        /** Integration ID. */
        id: string;
        /** Integration title. */
        title: string;
        /** Integration description. */
        description: string;
        /** URL path to the integration in Transcend. */
        link: string;
    }
    /** Payload passed to the default export of a data subject request function. */
    interface DataPointResolverProperties extends CommonPayloadProperties {
        /** Initial authenticated identifier submitted with the request. */
        coreIdentifier: CoreIdentifier;
        /** Datapoint-specific workflow metadata. */
        extras: CommonExtras & {
            /** Profile to look up. */
            profile: Profile;
            /** Integration being processed. */
            dataSilo: DataSilo;
            /** Asynchronous polling ID, when the integration is polling. */
            pollId: string | null | undefined;
        };
    }
    /** Input identifier passed to a request enricher. */
    interface RequestIdentifier {
        /** Identifier type name. */
        name: string;
        /** Identifier value. */
        value: string;
    }
    /** Request-enricher configuration metadata. */
    interface Enricher {
        /** Enricher ID. */
        id: string;
        /** Enricher title. */
        title: string;
    }
    /** Identifier type being enriched. */
    interface Identifier {
        /** Identifier type ID. */
        id: string;
        /** Unique identifier type name. */
        name: string;
        /** Identifier category. */
        type: string;
    }
    /** Payload passed to the `enricher` export of a data subject request function. */
    interface EnricherResolverProperties extends CommonPayloadProperties {
        /** Initial authenticated identifier submitted with the request. */
        coreIdentifier: CoreIdentifier;
        /** Identifier provided as input to the enricher. */
        requestIdentifier: RequestIdentifier;
        /** Enricher-specific workflow metadata. */
        extras: CommonExtras & {
            /** Enricher being processed. */
            enricher: Enricher;
            /** Identifier type being processed. */
            identifier: Identifier;
            /** Unique ID for this enricher and request combination. */
            requestEnricherId: string;
        };
    }
    /**
     * Webhook or schedule payload for a General Custom Function.
     *
     * Trigger data is free-form JSON. Transcend adds `coreIdentifier` on every
     * invocation; all other keys depend on the rule trigger or test payload.
     */
    interface GeneralResolverProperties {
        /** Initial authenticated identifier added by Transcend. */
        coreIdentifier: CoreIdentifier;
        /** Webhook or schedule fields from the rule trigger. */
        [key: string]: unknown;
    }
    /**
     * Payload supplied when locally testing a datapoint export.
     *
     * Transcend adds `coreIdentifier` and the resolved `dataSilo` when omitted.
     */
    type DataPointTestPayload = Omit<DataPointResolverProperties, 'coreIdentifier' | 'extras'> & {
        /** Optional override for the identifier Transcend would add. */
        coreIdentifier?: CoreIdentifier;
        /** Test metadata accepted before Transcend prepares the handler payload. */
        extras: Omit<DataPointResolverProperties['extras'], 'dataSilo' | 'profile' | 'pollId'> & {
            /** Optional integration override for a test invocation. */
            dataSilo?: DataSilo;
            /** Profile supplied by the test fixture. */
            profile: Omit<Profile, 'type'> & {
                /** Optional identifier descriptor accepted by the test endpoint. */
                type?: string | null;
            };
            /** Optional asynchronous polling ID accepted by the test endpoint. */
            pollId?: string | null;
        };
    };
    /**
     * Payload supplied when locally testing a request-enricher export.
     *
     * Transcend adds `coreIdentifier` when it is omitted.
     */
    type EnricherTestPayload = Omit<EnricherResolverProperties, 'coreIdentifier' | 'extras'> & {
        /** Optional override for the identifier Transcend would add. */
        coreIdentifier?: CoreIdentifier;
        /** Test metadata accepted before Transcend prepares the handler payload. */
        extras: EnricherResolverProperties['extras'] & {
            /** Integration used to route an unsaved test invocation. */
            dataSilo?: DataSilo;
        };
    };
    /**
     * Payload supplied when locally testing a General Custom Function.
     *
     * Transcend adds `coreIdentifier` when it is omitted.
     */
    interface GeneralTestPayload {
        /** Optional override for the identifier Transcend would add. */
        coreIdentifier?: CoreIdentifier;
        /** Webhook or schedule fields from the test fixture. */
        [key: string]: unknown;
    }
    /** Values accepted by the Custom Function key-value store. */
    type KVSerializableValue = string;
    /** Persistent key-value store injected into a Custom Function. */
    interface KV {
        /**
         * Retrieve a stored value.
         *
         * @param key - Stored value name
         * @returns Stored value, or `null` when the key does not exist
         */
        get: (key: string) => Promise<KVSerializableValue | null>;
        /**
         * Store a value.
         *
         * Keys are limited to 128 characters, values to 2,048 characters, and each Custom
         * Function may store at most 128 keys.
         *
         * @param key - Stored value name
         * @param value - Value to store
         */
        set: (key: string, value: KVSerializableValue) => Promise<void>;
        /**
         * List all stored keys.
         *
         * @returns Stored value names
         */
        keys: () => Promise<string[]>;
        /**
         * Check whether a key has a non-null value.
         *
         * @param key - Stored value name
         * @returns Whether the key has a value
         */
        has: (key: string) => Promise<boolean>;
        /**
         * Delete a stored value.
         *
         * @param key - Stored value name
         * @returns Whether the key existed
         */
        del: (key: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    }
    /** Options shared by every `sdk` helper that calls the Transcend API. */
    interface SdkApiOptions {
        /** API key to use instead of the `TRANSCEND_API_KEY` environment variable. */
        apiKey?: string;
    }
    /** Localized copy as returned by the Transcend API. */
    interface LocalizedMessage {
        /** Copy in the organization's default language. */
        defaultMessage: string;
    }
    /** A file listed for a privacy request. */
    interface RequestFile {
        /** Request file ID, matching `id` in the archive manifest. */
        id: string;
        /** Opaque key accepted by `GET /v1/files` to download the decrypted file. */
        downloadKey: string;
        /** Path of the file inside the archive before duplicate-name resolution. */
        fileName: string;
        /** Detected mime type, when known. */
        mimetype: string | null;
        /** Size in bytes, or `null` when unknown. */
        size: number | null;
        /** Error message recorded against the file, if any. */
        error: string | null;
        /** Datapoint that produced the file. */
        dataPoint: {
            /** Datapoint ID. */
            id: string;
            /** Datapoint machine name. */
            name: string;
            /** Human-readable title. */
            title?: LocalizedMessage | null;
            /** Human-readable description. */
            description?: LocalizedMessage | null;
            /** Data collection the datapoint is grouped under. */
            dataCollection?: {
                /** Data collection ID. */
                id: string;
                /** Data collection title. */
                title?: LocalizedMessage | null;
            } | null;
            /** Integration the datapoint belongs to. */
            dataSilo: {
                /** Integration ID. */
                id: string;
                /** Integration title. */
                title: string;
                /** Integration description. */
                description: string | null;
            };
        } | null;
    }
    /** Privacy Center branding returned by {@link SDK.getPrivacyCenterTheme}. */
    interface PrivacyCenterTheme {
        /** Accent color used for links and highlights. */
        primary: string;
        /** Secondary color, used for header bands. */
        secondary: string;
        /** Whether the Privacy Center uses a light or dark page. */
        colorMode: 'light' | 'dark';
        /** Logo as a `data:` URL, so a page that embeds it works offline. */
        logoDataUrl?: string;
    }
    /** Profile data returned to the data subject by {@link SDK.uploadProfiles}. */
    interface UploadedProfile {
        /** The data to return to the data subject. */
        profileData: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    /** File type that {@link SdkUtils.getFileFormat} can render inline. */
    type EmbeddableFileFormat = 'json' | 'csv' | 'text' | 'image';
    /** Pure helpers for building pages and processing files. */
    interface SdkUtils {
        /**
         * Escape a value for HTML text or attributes.
         *
         * @param value - Value to escape
         * @returns Escaped string
         */
        escapeHtml(value: unknown): string;
        /**
         * Serialize JSON that is safe inside a `<script>` tag.
         *
         * @param value - Value to serialize
         * @returns JSON string
         */
        toScriptJson(value: unknown): string;
        /**
         * Encode bytes as base64.
         *
         * @param bytes - Bytes to encode
         * @returns Base64 string
         */
        toBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string;
        /**
         * Format a byte count for display.
         *
         * @param size - Size in bytes, or `null` when unknown
         * @returns Human-readable size
         */
        formatBytes(size: number | null): string;
        /**
         * Read a non-negative number from an environment variable.
         *
         * @param value - Raw environment variable value
         * @param fallback - Value used when the variable is missing or invalid
         * @returns Parsed number
         */
        readNonNegativeNumber(value: string | undefined, fallback: number): number;
        /**
         * Run an async task over items with a fixed number of workers.
         *
         * @param items - Items to process
         * @param limit - Maximum number of tasks in flight
         * @param task - Task to run for each item
         * @returns Results in the same order as `items`
         */
        mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, task: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]>;
        /**
         * Decide how a file is shown when embedded in a page.
         *
         * @param file - File name and mime type
         * @returns The embed format, or `undefined` when the file is not embeddable
         */
        getFileFormat(file: {
            /** Path or name of the file. */
            fileName: string;
            /** Detected mime type, when known. */
            mimetype: string | null;
        }): EmbeddableFileFormat | undefined;
    }
    /** Convenience client for calling Transcend APIs. */
    class SDK {
        private customerIngressBaseUrl;
        private customerIngressAuth;
        private transcendNonce;
        constructor(customerIngressBaseUrl: string, customerIngressAuth: string, transcendNonce: string);
        /**
         * Return the nonce generated for this workflow invocation.
         *
         * @returns Workflow invocation nonce
         */
        nonce(): string;
        /**
         * Override the customer-ingress API base URL.
         *
         * @param newUrl - Customer-ingress API base URL
         */
        setCustomerIngressUrl(newUrl: string): void;
        /** Check the connection to Transcend. */
        ping(): Promise<void>;
        /**
         * Call a Transcend API path with the required Custom Function
         * authentication.
         *
         * @param path - Transcend API path
         * @param options - Fetch request options
         * @returns Fetch response
         */
        fetch(path: `/${string}`, options?: RequestInit): Promise<Response>;
        /**
         * Call a Transcend API path and parse the JSON response.
         *
         * Throws when the response is not successful. Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param path - Transcend API path
         * @param options - Fetch request options, plus an optional `apiKey`
         * @returns Parsed response body
         */
        fetchJson<T>(path: `/${string}`, options?: RequestInit & SdkApiOptions): Promise<T>;
        /**
         * Run a GraphQL query against the Transcend API.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param query - GraphQL document
         * @param variables - Query variables
         * @param options - Per-call options
         * @returns The `data` field of the response
         */
        graphql<T>(query: string, variables?: Record<string, unknown>, options?: SdkApiOptions): Promise<T>;
        /**
         * Return profiles for the current request and mark the data silo ready.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param options - Profiles to return and the status to set
         */
        uploadProfiles(options: SdkApiOptions & {
            /** Profiles to return to the data subject. */
            profiles: UploadedProfile[];
            /** Status to set on the data silo. Defaults to `READY`. */
            status?: 'READY';
        }): Promise<void>;
        /**
         * Mark this data silo complete without returning data.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param options - Per-call options
         */
        markDataSiloComplete(options?: SdkApiOptions): Promise<void>;
        /**
         * Upload one file to a datapoint.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param options - Datapoint, content and archive placement
         */
        uploadDataPoint(options: SdkApiOptions & {
            /** Datapoint on this data silo that receives the upload. */
            dataPointName: string;
            /** File content. */
            body: BodyInit;
            /** Content type of the file. */
            contentType: string;
            /** Identifier of the file within the datapoint. Defaults to `archivePath`. */
            remoteId?: string;
            /** Place the file at this path in the archive root. */
            archivePath?: string;
        }): Promise<void>;
        /**
         * List every file in the archive for a request.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param options - Request and filters
         * @returns All request files
         */
        listRequestFiles(options?: SdkApiOptions & {
            /** Request to list files for. Defaults to the current request. */
            requestId?: string;
            /** Leave out files produced by these integrations. */
            excludeDataSiloIds?: string[];
        }): Promise<RequestFile[]>;
        /**
         * Download and decrypt one request file through Sombra.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param file - File to download
         * @param options - Per-call options
         * @returns Response ready to read as text or bytes
         */
        downloadRequestFile(file: Pick<RequestFile, 'downloadKey'>, options?: SdkApiOptions): Promise<Response>;
        /**
         * Load Privacy Center colors and logo, falling back to a neutral theme.
         *
         * Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later.
         *
         * @param options - Per-call options
         * @returns Privacy Center theme
         */
        getPrivacyCenterTheme(options?: SdkApiOptions): Promise<PrivacyCenterTheme>;
        /** Pure helpers for building pages and processing files. Requires Sombra 7.656.0 or later. */
        utils: SdkUtils;
    }
    /** Values injected into every Custom Function handler. */
    interface Argument<Payload = DataPointResolverProperties> {
        /** Customer-configured environment variables. */
        environment: EnvironmentGlobals.Environment;
        /** Workflow payload for the selected function export. */
        payload: Payload;
        /** Convenience client for calling Transcend APIs. */
        sdk: SDK;
        /** Persistent key-value store. */
        kv: KV;
    }
    /** Argument passed to a data subject request enricher export. */
    type EnricherArgument = Argument<EnricherResolverProperties>;
    /** Argument passed to a General Custom Function. */
    type GeneralArgument = Argument<GeneralResolverProperties>;
    /** Supported return type for a Custom Function handler. */
    type HandlerResult = void | Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Default data subject request datapoint handler.
     *
     * @param argument - Datapoint invocation values
     * @returns Handler completion
     */
    type DataPointHandler = (argument: Argument<DataPointResolverProperties>) => HandlerResult;
    /**
     * Data subject request enricher handler.
     *
     * @param argument - Request-enricher invocation values
     * @returns Handler completion
     */
    type EnricherHandler = (argument: EnricherArgument) => HandlerResult;
    /**
     * General Custom Function handler.
     *
     * @param argument - General invocation values
     * @returns Handler completion
     */
    type GeneralHandler = (argument: GeneralArgument) => HandlerResult;
}
